Menu includes simple Tunisian dishes
May 2025 • Friends
Ojja and citronade. Indulged in final evening meal before leaving with my favourite Tunisian dish and my favourite Tunisian drink
Ojja is similar to shakshuka and is yummy with merguez sausage in it.
Ate here with group members who had not left for home and it was so nice to eat simple food as some of the group meals had been taken at French style restaurants
Reasonable price considering location.

Place to keep in mind
May 2024 • Solo
Café-restaurant located in the center, next to the Municipal Theatre. It stands out from the other hundreds of venues in the area for the tranquility of the environment and the efficiency of the service. It offers "Italian" and French cuisine, so it can prove providential if you want to spend an evening of "rest" from Tunisian food. The pizza, thin and crunchy, is not bad at all.
